title: SS Power Pro
description: Bringing handymen business online. Curated website which fits the client business accordingly. #WIP
overview: SS Power Pro needed a straightforward online presence for a hands-on service business. The website introduces the company, communicates the service offer clearly, and gives customers a simple route to get in touch.
challenge: The business needed to move from informal discovery to a more credible digital touchpoint. The challenge was to keep the website practical and direct while still making the brand feel reliable and professional.
strategy: We designed the page around service clarity, trust, and fast contact. The structure keeps messaging concise, uses responsive sections for easy scanning, and avoids unnecessary complexity for visitors who need quick answers.
solution: The final build gives SS Power Pro a tailored marketing site with a clean layout, focused service content, and a responsive experience across devices. It creates a stronger first impression while keeping the customer journey simple.
